title: "Tarot" (feat. Jhayco) Crosses 1 Billion Spotify Streams — Bad Bunny's 32nd Song to Reach the Mark, Surpassing The Weeknd's All-Time Record
detail: Bad Bunny's collaboration with Jhayco, 'Tarot' — the ethereal closing track on Un Verano Sin Ti (2022) — has crossed 1 billion streams on Spotify, becoming his 32nd individual track to surpass the milestone and the second billion-stream song from UVST added in May 2026 (alongside 'Qué Pasaría…' with Rauw Alejandro). With 32 songs over 1 billion Spotify streams, Bad Bunny now holds the all-time record as the artist with the most individual billion-stream tracks in Spotify history, moving ahead of The Weeknd's 31. The milestone traces back across his entire catalog: early trap singles ('Soy Peor,' 'Krippy Kush,' 'MIA'), YHLQMDLG ('SAFAERA,' 'Yo Perreo Sola,' 'Dakiti'), El Último Tour del Mundo ('La Noche de Anoche'), Un Verano Sin Ti ('Me Porto Bonito,' 'Tití Me Preguntó,' 'Ojitos Lindos,' 'El Apagón,' 'Moscow Mule,' 'Tarot'), Nadie Sabe Lo Que Va a Pasar Mañana ('UN PREVIEW'), and now Debí Tirar Más Fotos. 'Tarot,' recorded with Puerto Rican singer-songwriter Jhayco — who co-starred on Bad Bunny's global smash 'Dakiti' (2020) — is a tender, ambient meditation on love and fate, blending Jhayco's falsetto harmonics with sparse production that stands in deliberate contrast to UVST's club anthems. The song originally reached #1 on Hot Latin Songs in 2022. The cumulative record cements Bad Bunny's catalog supremacy: across four studio albums released 2018–2025, not a single era has failed to produce multiple billion-stream tracks — an achievement unmatched in Latin music. The milestone lands five days before the European leg of the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour opens at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys in Barcelona (May 22–23, sold out).
